message: Hello again. Have you found the former warden in Flagstone yet?

replies.text: I found the warden. He attacked me, so I had no choice but to kill him. I found this necklace on him.

message: Oh, the wardens necklace! He used to be very protective about it. I wonder if it had any special purpose. Maybe you should search the prison more thoroughly, you never know what secrets it might hold.

replies.text: Alright, I will go and have another look.
